Use case: precise-object-edit. Production game sprite replacement for Don't Starve Together.
Image 1 is the exact transparent torso sprite layout/pose template. Image 2 is approved character clothing identity. Redraw the 11 isolated TORSO parts in image 1 as the clothing of the female blue-black moon assassin from image 2. Do NOT draw full people, heads, hair, arms, hands, legs, weapon or text.
Keep image 1's canvas size/aspect, exact five-column cell arrangement and order: row 1 five torsos 0-4, row 2 five torsos 5-9, row 3 ONE torso 10 at far left and four empty cells. Keep every part's tilt, orientation, perspective and central top neck attachment point. Do not normalize all to one front view.
Clothing: charcoal fitted tunic, angular dark navy short shoulder cape/high collar, small SILVER CRESCENT clasp plus tiny sapphire at chest when facing front, subtle navy layered waist sash, two short pointed split coat tails extending downward. Clean thick black DST ink contour, muted flat shaded dark navy/charcoal, tiny simplified detail readable at game scale. Each torso may extend about 20 percent wider and 35 percent taller than original, principally downward from fixed neck point for the split tails, but remains isolated in its own cell.
Exact views: row1 col1 straight front, col2 front bending/leaning right, col3 front bending/leaning left, col4 narrow side/back three-quarter, col5 side three-quarter tilted left. Row2 col1 side tilted right, col2 BACK straight with short navy cape and no chest clasp visible, col3 BACK leaning right, col4 BACK leaning left. Row2 col5 (index9) is the original FLATTENED OVAL END-ON TOP/BOTTOM VIEW, retain that flattened oval perspective with folds, not another standing front torso. Row3 col1 (index10) is a SPECIAL X-RAY SKELETON torso: preserve visible white ribs, spine and pelvis in the same tilt, framed with dark new cloth/cape rim; do not conceal its bones.
Genuine transparent background. No grid lines, labels, numbers, scenery, title, border, or white backgrounds. All 11 distinct parts, no added slots.
